product: Save reusable query templates in Google Sheets
tagline: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets now lets you save imports as a reusable template that you and your team can run in one step, each with your own Unity Catalog permissions.
what_it_does: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets now lets you save imports as a reusable template that you and your team can run in one step, each with your own Unity Catalog permissions. The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets queries data from your Databricks workspace and imports it into Google Sheets. You can select tables directly, write SQL queries, add parameters, create pivot tables, and import from templates.
why_it_matters: Calculated fields A calculated field is a column derived from existing data, such as profit computed from revenue and cost.
